record: Purdue Village Administration Building (West Lafayette, Ind.)
capture_type: Search-indexed page content; direct HTML fetch received a Cloudflare browser challenge
captured_claims: The facility provided 23,000 gross square feet of new space for Married Student Housing.

The building provided administrative offices, storage for furniture, plumbing fixtures, electrical supplies, appliances, paint, plaster, cleaning equipment, grounds-maintenance service/storage, and residence-hall storage.
Historic alternate names include Married Student Housing Administration Building and Married Student Housing Office, Shops and Storage Building.
limitations: This source supports identity and historic use, not exact current footprint, plan, level count, height, facade, or roof geometry. The associated historical database citation is building record 74.
